kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.gmOnly: Only the GM can run this macro.
kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.replaced: Replaced {replaced} actor(s) with cyclops versions, refreshed {refreshed} already-replaced actor(s), updated {spells} spell(s), and updated {tokens} scene token(s).
kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.restored: Replaced {spells} spell(s) with the pf2e originals on {actors} cyclops actor(s) and {tokens} scene token(s).
kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.noneFound: None of the chosen Kingmaker actors are in this world. Import the Kingmaker adventure first.

dialog.title: Kingmaker: Make Cyclopes
dialog.content: Replace which actors with their cyclops versions? Actors already replaced keep their data and only get fresh art, full HP, and remastered spells.

kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.artImported: Imported the Candlemere Spiral Art journal.
kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.artKept: Kept the existing Candlemere Spiral Art journal.
kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.candlemere: {journal} Placed {creatures} creature token(s), pinned {notes} art note(s), and gave {actors} actor(s) and {tokens} scene token(s) new art.

helix.placed: Placed {tiles} hidden Helix Theorem tile(s) on the Candlemere Spiral.
helix.noScene: This world has no Candlemere Spiral scene. Import it from Kingmaker first.

dialog.title: Helix Theorem
dialog.content: Change all nine Helix Theorem tiles at once. To seal or open one gate, right-click its tile on the Tiles layer.
